description: ONLY 12,000 MILES, TURBOCHARGED, FACTORY WARRANTY, HONDA SENSING, NONSMOKER, SUPER RELIABLE! The 2025 Honda Accord Sedan SE brings a little extra attitude to one of America's most respected midsize sedans, combining the Accord's spacious cabin, polished road manners, excellent everyday efficiency, and strong reputation with distinctive SE styling and comfort upgrades. Finished in Crystal Black Pearl and showing only 12,084 miles, this exceptionally low-mileage Accord offers the refinement of Honda's latest-generation sedan with plenty of FACTORY WARRANTY remaining. With an original MSRP of $31,755, the SE occupies an appealing spot in the Accord lineup. It builds on the well-equipped LX with heated front seats, a power driver's seat, dual-zone automatic climate control, a moonroof, and distinctive black exterior details -- all while retaining Honda's responsive turbocharged powertrain and comprehensive Honda Sensing safety technology. Why Shoppers Buy the Honda Accord The Accord has spent decades earning its reputation by doing the fundamentals exceptionally well. It offers genuine room for five adults, a large trunk, comfortable ride quality, predictable handling, strong fuel economy, and controls that are refreshingly easy to understand. The current generation adds a cleaner, more sophisticated design and an impressively spacious cabin without abandoning the straightforward usability that has long made the Accord such a compelling daily driver. The SE adds just enough visual personality and premium equipment to make that proven formula more interesting. Automotive Press & Industry Recognition The 2025 Honda Accord earned a 2025 CAR AND DRIVER 10BEST award. The 2025 Honda Accord also earned an IIHS TOP SAFETY PICK+ award. Warranty This Accord was originally registered on May 19, 2025 and now shows only 12,084 miles, leaving substantial FACTORY WARRANTY coverage remaining. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage New Vehicle Limited Warranty -- through May 19, 2028 or 36,000 miles, whichever occurs first. Powertrain Limited Warranty -- through May 19, 2030 or 60,000 miles, whichever occurs first. Federal emissions coverage may provide additional protection for qualifying emissions-related components under applicable Honda warranty terms. That remaining factory protection makes this low-mileage Accord especially attractive for someone looking for a nearly new ownership experience without necessarily buying brand new. STILL COVERED indeed! Standard Features The SE adds several meaningful upgrades over the Accord LX, including heated front seats, a 10-way power-adjustable driver's seat with power lumbar support, dual-zone automatic climate control, a power moonroof, and SE-specific exterior details. Other everyday conveniences include Smart Entry with Walk Away Auto Lock, push-button start, remote engine start, automatic LED headlights, LED daytime running lights, variable intermittent wipers, a multi-angle rearview camera, and a spacious 16.7-cubic-foot trunk. Mechanical Features Honda's 1.5-liter turbocharged four-cylinder produces 192 horsepower and 192 lb-ft of torque, giving the Accord responsive low- and mid-range power for commuting, merging, and highway passing. Turbocharging helps deliver useful torque without requiring a larger-displacement engine, contributing to the Accord's appealing combination of performance and efficiency. The continuously variable transmission is tuned to work smoothly with the turbocharged engine, while Normal and Econ drive modes allow the driver to prioritize everyday response or efficiency. Front-wheel drive, independent suspension, electric power-assisted steering, and four-wheel disc brakes give the Accord the composed and predictable road manners for which the nameplate is known. EPA estimates for the 2025 Accord SE are an impressive 29 MPG city, 37 MPG highway, and 32 MPG combined. Exterior Features Crystal Black Pearl works particularly well with the SE's darker exterior treatment, creating a clean monochromatic appearance with just enough sporting character. The SE adds black exterior accents and distinctive 17'' alloy wheels, giving it a subtly more assertive look without becoming overstated. LED headlights and daytime running lights provide a modern lighting signature, while the power moonroof is a particularly welcome SE upgrade. The Accord's long, low roofline and clean body surfacing give it a sophisticated profile that looks considerably more upscale than the traditional family-sedan formula might suggest. Interior Features The Accord's cabin is one of its strongest assets, with excellent outward visibility, generous passenger room, and a clean horizontal dashboard that avoids unnecessary clutter. The SE improves the everyday experience with heated front seats, dual-zone automatic climate control, and a 10-way power driver's seat with power lumbar adjustment. Rear-seat passengers benefit from the Accord's generous legroom, while the 16.7-cubic-foot trunk provides excellent luggage capacity for a midsize sedan. A folding rear seat adds flexibility for longer cargo when needed. Infotainment & Technology A 7'' touchscreen infotainment system provides access to core audio and connectivity functions, complemented by a 10.2'' digital instrument display directly ahead of the driver. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility make it easy to bring familiar smartphone functions into the vehicle. Bluetooth HandsFreeLink and streaming audio, USB connectivity, steering-wheel-mounted controls, and a multi-angle rearview camera provide the technology most drivers use regularly without overwhelming the cabin with unnecessary complexity. Safety Features Honda Sensing gives every Accord SE a substantial collection of driver-assistance technology. The Collision Mitigation Braking System can help detect and respond to potential frontal collisions, while the Road Departure Mitigation System, Lane Keeping Assist System, Lane Departure Warning, Forward Collision Warning, and Traffic Sign Recognition provide additional assistance during everyday driving. Adaptive Cruise Control with Low-Speed Follow can automatically manage following distance in changing traffic conditions, while Traffic Jam Assist can provide steering assistance at lower speeds. Blind Spot Information with Cross Traffic Monitor adds valuable awareness when changing lanes or backing from a parking space. The 2025 Accord's IIHS TOP SAFETY PICK+ recognition provides meaningful independent validation of Honda's comprehensive approach to occupant protection and crash avoidance. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Bottom Line With only 12,084 miles, a $31,755 original MSRP, substantial FACTORY WARRANTY remaining, an efficient 192-horsepower turbocharged engine, Honda Sensing technology, and the SE's desirable heated seats, moonroof, power driver's seat, and dual-zone climate control, this Accord delivers an unusually complete everyday package. It is comfortable without being soft, efficient without feeling underpowered, spacious without feeling oversized, and sophisticated without becoming unnecessarily complicated. The Accord formula was already good -- the SE simply gives it a little more personality. description: EFFICIENT, PRACTICAL, WELL-EQUIPPED, ONE-OWNER, NO-ACCIDENT, NONSMOKER, EASY TO LOVE! The 2025 Hyundai Venue continues to prove that a subcompact SUV doesn't need a big price tag to feel like a smart, complete package. Built around the idea that most buyers don't need a bigger footprint or a longer feature list -- they need something efficient, easy to live with, and genuinely affordable to own -- the Venue has quietly become one of the segment's most sensible choices. Finished in Ecotronic Gray over a well-equipped SEL trim, this Venue pairs that everyday practicality with a genuinely low cost of ownership, making it an easy vehicle to recommend to anyone tired of feeling nickel-and-dimed by their current SUV. Why Shoppers Buy This Model Shoppers choose the Venue because it delivers real subcompact SUV utility -- a comfortable, upright seating position, a surprisingly usable cargo area, and easy maneuverability in tight city spaces -- without the premium price or thirsty fuel economy that comes with larger crossovers. It's a vehicle built for buyers who want SUV practicality on a genuinely sensible budget. That budget-friendly reputation isn't just marketing -- the Venue has repeatedly earned the KELLEY BLUE BOOK LOWEST 5-YEAR COST TO OWN recognition among subcompact SUVs, a distinction it has carried nearly every year since it went on sale, reflecting genuinely strong resale value, efficient fuel economy, and low expected maintenance costs over time. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage New Vehicle (Basic) Limited Warranty -- Covers bumper-to-bumper components. Expiration: 08/18/2030 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. Expiration: 08/18/2030 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. Anti-Perforation (Corrosion) Limited Warranty -- Covers rust-through of body sheet metal. Expiration: 08/18/2032. Extended service plans may be available to provide additional peace of mind and help protect your investment moving forward. Standard Features The SEL trim brings genuine step-up equipment to the Venue lineup, starting with rear disc brakes in place of the base trim's drum setup and a leather-wrapped steering wheel that immediately makes the cabin feel more upscale. A power sunroof opens up the interior and lets in natural light, a feature that's often reserved for far pricier SUVs. Blind-Spot Collision Warning adds real driver confidence in traffic and parking lots, rounding out a trim level that genuinely earns its place above the base SE. Mechanical Features Power comes from a 1.6-liter four-cylinder engine that prioritizes smooth, efficient operation over outright urgency, paired with Hyundai's Intelligent Variable Transmission for seamless, stepless acceleration. It's an easygoing combination that suits the Venue's mission as a low-fuss daily driver rather than a performance-focused SUV. Front-wheel drive keeps the powertrain simple and efficient, contributing directly to the Venue's class-leading fuel economy and low running costs -- exactly what budget-minded subcompact SUV shoppers are looking for. Exterior Features Ecotronic Gray gives this Venue a clean, understated look that wears well over time, complementing the SEL trim's upright, confident stance. The available sunroof adds a touch of openness to what is otherwise a purposefully efficient exterior design. Compact overall dimensions make this Venue easy to park and maneuver in tight city spaces, without sacrificing the commanding view of the road that draws buyers to SUVs in the first place. Interior Features Inside, the SEL's leather-wrapped steering wheel adds a welcome touch of refinement to what remains a practical, easy-to-clean cabin. The sunroof brightens the interior considerably, making the cabin feel larger and more inviting than the Venue's compact footprint might suggest. Despite its small dimensions, the Venue's upright greenhouse and thoughtful packaging deliver genuinely usable cargo space, making it a practical daily companion for errands, commuting, and the occasional larger haul. Infotainment & Technology The Venue's infotainment system keeps things simple and intuitive, with Bluetooth connectivity for hands-free calling and music streaming, along with an accessible touchscreen interface that doesn't overwhelm first-time owners. It's technology built for everyday usability rather than flash -- exactly in keeping with the Venue's straightforward, value-focused personality. Safety Features Forward collision warning with automatic emergency braking comes standard, helping the Venue anticipate and respond to hazards before the driver can react. Lane-keeping assist works alongside it to help keep the vehicle centered during highway stretches. The SEL trim adds Blind-Spot Collision Warning on top of that foundation, giving drivers extra awareness during lane changes and reinforcing the Venue's reputation as a genuinely safety-conscious choice in the subcompact SUV class. ... and there's SO MUCH more! description: FAMILY-READY, SPACIOUS, WELL-EQUIPPED, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, ROOM FOR EVERYONE! The 2025 Volkswagen Atlas SE with Technology 4MOTION is the kind of three-row SUV that makes everyday family life easier without feeling oversized or cumbersome from behind the wheel. Finished in Platinum Gray Metallic, this Atlas combines seating for seven, a genuinely spacious cabin, strong turbocharged performance, and the added confidence of 4MOTION ALL-WHEEL DRIVE in a clean, modern package. With 42,059 miles, ONE-OWNER history, and remaining FACTORY WARRANTY coverage, this Atlas also brings the reassurance buyers want in a late-model family SUV. The SE with Technology trim is especially appealing because it adds meaningful everyday conveniences rather than simply dressing up the exterior. Why Shoppers Buy This Model Space is the Atlas calling card. Volkswagen designed it as a true three-row family SUV, with an adult-friendly second row, a genuinely usable third row, and enough cargo room to remain practical even when every seating position is needed. Access to the third row is straightforward, making school runs, carpools, road trips, and everyday errands considerably easier. The Atlas also strikes an appealing balance on the road. Its turbocharged engine provides plenty of usable torque, while 4MOTION helps add confidence when rain, snow, or changing road surfaces enter the picture. Despite the generous interior dimensions, the driving experience remains composed and approachable rather than truck-like. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The Atlas has earned praise throughout its current generation for its spacious three-row interior, impressive cargo capacity, family-friendly packaging, and straightforward road manners. Those strengths are particularly relevant here because the SE with Technology trim adds many of the convenience features families are most likely to appreciate every day. Warranty The odometer shows 42,059 miles. Originally registered February 27, 2025, this Atlas remains within Volkswagen's original 4-year/50,000-mile New Vehicle Limited Warranty based on the supplied in-service date and current mileage. BUY WITH CONFIDENCE AS THE FACTORY WARRANTY IS STILL INTACT! Standard Features SE with Technology builds on an already well-equipped Atlas with a particularly useful collection of family-oriented upgrades. Remote engine start makes it easier to prepare the cabin before everyone climbs aboard, while the hands-free Easy Open power rear liftgate simplifies loading when your hands are full. The cabin adds heated and ventilated front seats, a heated steering wheel, three-zone automatic climate control, keyless access with push-button start, and thoughtful storage throughout. The combination makes this Atlas equally comfortable handling the daily commute, school pickups, or an all-day family road trip. Mechanical Features Volkswagen's turbocharged 2.0-liter four-cylinder produces 269 horsepower and 273 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission. The engine's strong torque output gives this three-row SUV confident response around town and enough reserve power for merging, passing, and highway travel with the family aboard. 4MOTION ALL-WHEEL DRIVE actively manages power delivery according to driving conditions, providing added traction when it is useful without keeping the rear axle continuously engaged when it is not needed. Selectable drive settings further tailor the vehicle's responses for different surfaces and conditions. Towing & Utility SE with Technology adds an integrated trailer hitch, and this configuration can tow up to 5,000 lbs with a properly equipped braked trailer. That gives the Atlas useful flexibility for a small camper, recreational equipment, or other family toys without sacrificing the comfort and maneuverability that make it such an easy everyday SUV. Exterior Features Platinum Gray Metallic gives the Atlas a sophisticated, understated appearance that works especially well with its broad stance and clean body lines. LED exterior lighting contributes to the modern look while providing excellent nighttime visibility. The SE with Technology treatment adds larger alloy wheels and additional convenience equipment, while the hands-free power liftgate makes the substantial rear cargo area much easier to use when loading groceries, luggage, sports equipment, or strollers. Interior Features Three-row seating for seven is one of the biggest reasons families gravitate toward the Atlas. There is generous room throughout the cabin, and the second- and third-row seating can fold to transform the interior from people-hauler to cargo-hauler when the day's plans change. Cargo capacity is another Atlas strength, with approximately 20.6 cu ft available behind the third row, 55.5 cu ft behind the second row, and as much as 96.6 cu ft with the rear seating folded. That flexibility means you do not have to give up useful luggage space simply because you occasionally need all three rows. Infotainment & Technology A large 12'' center touchscreen gives the Atlas a modern command center for infotainment and vehicle functions, complemented by Volkswagen's Digital Cockpit Pro instrument display directly ahead of the driver. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility make smartphone integration especially convenient, while wireless device charging helps reduce cable clutter. Multiple USB-C charging ports help keep everyone's devices powered on longer trips, while Bluetooth connectivity and connected Volkswagen services add another layer of everyday convenience. Safety Features Volkswagen's IQ.DRIVE technology provides an extensive collection of driver-assistance features designed to reduce workload and add confidence in busy traffic. Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Assist, Front Assist, Active Blind Spot Monitor, Rear Traffic Alert, and Travel Assist work together to support the driver during everyday travel. Front and rear parking sensors are particularly useful in a three-row SUV, while the rearview camera helps make backing into parking spaces and maneuvering around crowded driveways considerably easier. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! The Atlas succeeds because it focuses on the things that matter most in a family SUV: ROOM FOR EVERYONE, flexible cargo space, easy everyday technology, useful towing capability, and confident ALL-WHEEL DRIVE. Add this example's ONE-OWNER history, remaining FACTORY WARRANTY, and well-equipped SE with Technology trim, and it becomes a particularly practical way to put a late-model three-row SUV in the driveway. Load up the family, pack the cargo area, and pick a destination -- this Atlas is ready for all of it.
